# SSS Associate

> SSS Associate provides enquiries and assistance relating to legal advisory, property documentation, land survey, accounts, auditing, loan assistance, debt restructuring, debt settlement, and bank auction support, subject to service availability and applicable professional requirements.

## Website

- Homepage: https://sss-associate.vercel.app/

## Services

- Legal advisory and legal opinion enquiries
- Property document verification and registration assistance
- Land survey and boundary verification assistance
- Accounts management and bookkeeping
- Auditing and assurance
- Bank loan assistance
- Loan takeover and debt restructuring enquiries
- Debt settlement and One-Time Settlement (OTS) assistance
- Real estate and property-related assistance
- SARFAESI bank auction support

## Service Area

- Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
- Tamil Nadu, India

## Important Information

Service availability and outcomes depend on individual circumstances, applicable requirements, and the relevant institutions or professionals. Contact SSS Associate to confirm the availability and scope of a specific service.
